I be farming this land for yam and cassava, and even though I dey rent am, I must make sure the harvest is strong because my family depend on it. Chemical fertilizer dey costly but for tubers I go apply small NPK to help the yam size up, plus I go carry goat and chicken droppings from my compound to spread on the mounds. I no fit afford irrigation — I go depend on the rain like my fathers before me — but I go buy small gramoxone to control the weeds because labor too expensive these days. My wife and my two older children go help me on the farm, and for heavy work like making mounds and harvesting I go hire small boys from the village.
